name: environment-setup
description: Validate repository structure, required tools, harness/provider setup, and evaluator syntax.

optionalInputs.name: autoApprove
optionalInputs.description: Allow harness permission auto-approval during generation test.

prechecks.description: Node.js is required for evaluator syntax checks.

expectedOutputs.description: Setup validation exits successfully and optionally produces WORKSPACE/.test-setup.

diagnostics: Check missing directories, missing harness CLI, provider credentials, or evaluator syntax failures.
Setup validation may perform a real generation run unless the underlying script is changed.

instructions: Install missing tools or configure credentials, then rerun setup validation.
Use --keep-test-files when inspecting failed setup generation output.
